# Synthetic PASS Deliverable

A minimal compliant deliverable used to prove the ground gate emits the honest badge.

## 6. Methodology

### Source Evaluation

Independent Phase 3.5 verification was run by a distinct verifier agent (`verify-z9y8x7`),
separate from the synthesis agent (`synth-a1b2c3`).

- Verification sample size: 3 sampled out of 3 total cards (100%).
- Failure count: 0.
- Failure-rate band: ≤5%.
